_how_these_were_computed: By hand. Flat 100 a day x 6 min = 10.0 hours, share 100%. Ann works weekdays 8h. Max 3 days in a row. Walk: 25 to 27 Nov short 2.0, Bo added each day (run 1, 2, 3; week hours 6, 12, 18). 28 Nov Sat: Ann would make 4 in a row, Bo is off: backlog 10. 29 Nov Sun: Ann would join her 30 Nov to 4 Dec run (6 days), Bo added (week hours 24): 20 - 6 = 14. 30 Nov: 24 - 14 = 10 (Bo added). 1 Dec: 20 - 14 = 6 (Bo, run 3). 2 Dec: Bo would be 4 in a row: 16 - 8 = 8. 3 Dec: Bo added: 18 - 14 = 4. 4 Dec: Bo added (week hours 24): 14 - 14 = 0. 5 Dec Sat: Ann would be 6 in a row, Bo would go to 30 hours: backlog 10. Without the draft Ann alone ends every day short: 2, 4, 6, 16, 26, 28, 30, 32, 34, 36, 46.
